scenes.text: Have you ever wondered why modern concrete crumbles in decades, but ancient Roman harbors still stand after two thousand years?
For centuries, scientists were baffled by how Roman concrete survived relentless, crashing ocean waves, but recently researchers uncovered a mind-blowing secret.
The Romans used volcanic ash and lime, which triggers a chemical reaction when seawater seeps into cracks, literally growing new minerals to self-heal.
Would you live in a self-healing concrete house? Drop a comment below and follow for more insane history mysteries.
